thread.title: Trump comments on Apple iPhone tariffs may be a ‘negotiating tactic,’ says UBS

author: Stocks News Feed
title: Trump comments on Apple iPhone tariffs may be a ‘negotiating tactic,’ says UBS
text:
UBS analyst Timothy Arcuri weighed in Tuesday with his thoughts on President Donald Trump’s recent comments that iPhones might be included in a forthcoming round of tariffs. “Apple
 AAPL, -0.83%
 is a significant employer in China and this administration has urged the company to move more manufacturing to the U.S.,” Arcuri wrote. “This could simply be a negotiating tactic ahead of the G20 Summit later this week, though we do note that this administration has proven a willingness to push forward with such actions.” He notes that it’s unclear whether Trump would impose 10% or 25% tariffs on iPhones if he were to go through with such a measure, but Arcuri estimates a 33-cent hit to fiscal 2019 EPS assuming a 10% rate. “We think Apple could ultimately mitigate any tariff impact but this would clearly take time as even the $10 billion Foxconn facility in Wisconsin is intended to make LCDs and any mitigation would increase Apple’s costs.” Apple shares are off 0.5% in Tuesday morning trading, and they’ve slipped 19% over the past month. The Dow Jones Industrial Average
 DJIA, -0.35%
 has fallen 0.4% in that time.
